results.evidence: Sources split: a climbing-club route page gives 7 miles and 2,100 ft from the first switchback, while the 1975 party's report gives about 4 miles and 2,600 ft round trip from the Smith Brook Meadows pullout, and a winter page gives 4 miles including a 2-mile road walk. The route's own pins (road to Lichtenwasser Lake about 1.1 km straight-line, lake to summit about 1.2 km) favour roughly 2 miles one way, i.e. the stored dist_km of 3.2, but no two independent sources agree on a single round-trip figure. The itinerary's '4 to 7 miles' already brackets both; the beta's flat '7-mile' is the claim most likely wrong but is left until sources agree.

results.evidence: The Lichtenberg Boulders are a cluster below a large slab on the mountain, about 2.5 miles from the Smithbrook trailhead, reached mostly on the Lake Valhalla/McCausland trail plus a short bushwhack — the sibling west-side approach, not the Lichtenwasser Lake fishing trail this route uses; the pin's distMi 2.5 is that trail's mileage. results.fact: Round-trip distance: three disagreeing figures for the same route
results.correct_value: About 9 miles round trip (about 4.5 miles / 7.2 km one way): ~0.9 mi to the PCT, ~3.4 mi to the lake's south tip, ~4.5 mi to the summit.
results.evidence: A trip log via Lake Valhalla recorded 9 miles and 2,300 ft; another recorded 9.2 miles and 2,594 ft; a third gives about 4 miles one way. A step-by-step description sums to 0.9 + 1.7 + 0.3 to the lake junction, 0.5 along the shore, 0.7 to the gully, then the gully and 0.2 west along the ridge — about 4.3-4.5 miles one way; the lake alone is about 3.3-3.5 miles one way (6.6-7.0 mi round trip). So overview and itinerary (~9 mi) are right, and dist_km, the approach's '7 miles' and the waypoint mileages beyond the PCT junction were low by about a mile.
